push.title: W 2-1 vs Jawnsons | You: 8.8 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Your 5th best match performance of the season, buddskees. An 8.8 that did its job.

THE GOOD
+ 90% passing on 39 attempts, up from your usual 79%. Simple, smart and successful. My three favorite S's.
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. You hit the frame, and that's how you give yourself a chance.
+ 1 key pass. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ Man of the Match, your 15th for us. The game noticed, and so did I.
+ PhogsToffees finished what you started. That's teamwork.

THE BAD
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Focus point: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound. We'll drill it till it's dull.
- Tackle success 0%, down from your usual 35%. Not who you are, but it was who showed up.
- Both you and BellyTb1 dipped on finishing. Lean on each other: square it when the keeper commits.

Backyard drill: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.

Before you go, buddskees: The comeback is always more fun than the setback.

Let the lesson stick, let the frustration go. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.5, your 4th best match performance of the season. You're trending the right way.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at Jawnsons's goal. You were knocking on that door like you were selling encyclopedias.
+ Tackles attempted 4, up from your usual 2. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ 6th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (18 vs their best 14). Small wins add up to big ones.
+ 1 key pass lifted +0.1. Small hinge, big door.

THE BAD
- 2 of 6 shots on target. Little adjustment: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands. We'll get there together.
- Missed tackles 3, up from your usual 1. Homework: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.
- Giveaways 9, up from your usual 5. That's the bit that kept us from winning.
- Key passes: 1. Top forwards reach 2+. You've got the legs for it.

Muscle memory: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

PhogsToffees, take this with you: The best ability is availability, and the second best is kindness.

Keep raising the bar, I'll keep raising the clipboard. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 2-1 vs Jawnsons | You: 7.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.5. Good enough to be proud of, close enough to great to be hungry.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at Jawnsons's goal. Shoot your shot. You did, over and over.
+ PhogsToffees scored, but that goal had your name in the credits.
+ Passes attempted 33, up from your usual 19. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.
+ Tackles won 2, up from your usual 1. Proof you've got another gear.
+ Better match rating than any of their humans (7.5 vs their best 7.0). Gold star, no notes.

THE BAD
- 73% passing (24 of 33). Here's the play: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it. You've got this.
- 0 goals from 5 on target. For next time: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide. Clean it up and fly.
- You and buddskees were both flagged for finishing. Fix it as a pair: square it when the keeper commits.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.5 (best was buddskees's 8.8). It's a small thing until it's the whole thing.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 2 (best was buddskees's 4). That's where the match slipped.

Coach's drill: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

BellyTb1, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: The ball will find the player who wants it. Want it.

Hard days make strong players. - Coach Lasso
